title: Azure vs AWS: Building Block Equivalents

scenes.line1: Azure or AWS—do you know the names?
scenes.say: Azure and AWS use different names for the same building blocks. Can you match them up?
Resource Group in Azure is like a CloudFormation stack in AWS. VNet and subnet map to VPC and subnet. NSG matches up with Security Group, and Virtual Machine is EC2.
Azure DNS becomes Route 53 in AWS. Key Vault is matched by Secrets Manager. Storage Account is S3, and AKS aligns with EKS.

scenes.question: Can NSGs filter by domain name?
scenes.right: No, NSGs only filter by IP and port. Domain filtering needs Azure Firewall.
scenes.say: Watch out: NSGs only filter by IP and port—not domain names. For domain filtering, you need Azure Firewall.
